hook.line: Telling someone what to do rarely goes well, especially in the middle of an argument. Spanish has a softer way in: "it would be best if". Vale uses it when Tomás is about to sign something in a hurry.
hook.es: Lo mejor sería que esperáramos un poco.
hook.en: It would be best if we waited a little.

examples.es: Lo mejor sería que fueras al médico.
examples.en: It would be best if you went to the doctor. (to a friend)

examples.es: Si yo fuera tú, hablaría con Hernando.
examples.en: If I were you, I'd talk to Hernando. (to a friend)

examples.es: Te recomendaría que hablaras con ella.
examples.en: I'd recommend that you talk to her. (to a friend)

examples.es: Lo mejor sería que esperáramos un poco.
examples.en: It would be best if we waited a little.

examples.es: Si yo fuera usted, no firmaría.
examples.en: If I were you, I wouldn't sign. (formal)
I'd recommend that you all think it over.

rule:
Three soft ways to give advice:

*Lo mejor sería que* + the "imagined" verb: *fueras*, *esperáramos*.
*Si yo fuera tú,* + a *would* verb: *hablaría*, *firmaría*.
*Te recomendaría que* + the same imagined verb: *hablaras*.

English does it with "went", "waited", "were". Spanish too: the verb after *que* looks past-tense, but it is only polite distance. For *tú* it ends in *-ras* (*fueras*, *hablaras*); for *we* in *-ramos* (*esperáramos*); for *ustedes* in *-ran* (*pensaran*).

Use *usted* when you must be formal: *Si yo fuera usted*.
smallPrint: Teachers call the *fueras* form the imperfect subjunctive, and the *would* verb the conditional.

readAndPick.es: Lo mejor sería que fueras al médico.
options: It would be best if you went to the doctor.
It would be best if we went to the doctor.
It was best that you went to the doctor.

readAndPick.es: Lo mejor sería que esperáramos un poco.
options: It would be best if you waited a little.
It would be best if we waited a little.
It would be best if they waited a little.

readAndPick.es: Si yo fuera tú, no firmaría eso.
options: If I am you, I won't sign that.
When I was you, I didn't sign that.
If I were you, I wouldn't sign that.

readAndPick.es: Te recomendaría que hablaras con ella.
options: I'd recommend that you talk to her.
I recommended that she talk to you.
I recommend that you talk to her.
I'd recommend that you think it over. (one person)
I'd recommend that you all think it over.
I'd recommend that we think it over.

readAndPick.es: Lo mejor sería que me dijeras la verdad.
options: It would be best if I told you the truth.
It would be best if she told me the truth.
It would be best if you told me the truth.

readAndPick.es: Si yo fuera tú, le pediría perdón.
options: If I were you, I'd apologise to him.
If I were you, I asked him for a favour.
If I am you, I apologise to him.

readAndPick.es: Si yo fuera usted, no firmaría.
options: If I were you, I wouldn't sign. (to a friend)
If I were you, I wouldn't sign. (formal)
If he were me, he wouldn't sign.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *fueras* or *vas*. To a friend: Lo mejor sería que ___ al médico. Type the whole sentence.
yourTurn.answer: Lo mejor sería que fueras al médico.
yourTurn.why: After *lo mejor sería que* the verb takes the imagined form: *fueras*.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *hablaría* or *hablo*. To a friend: Si yo fuera tú, ___ con Hernando. Type the whole sentence.
yourTurn.answer: Si yo fuera tú, hablaría con Hernando.
yourTurn.why: After *si yo fuera tú* comes the *would* verb: *hablaría*.

yourTurn.prompt: If I were you, I wouldn't sign that. (to a friend)
yourTurn.answer: Si yo fuera tú, no firmaría eso.
accept: Si fuera tú, no firmaría eso.
yourTurn.why: *Si yo fuera tú* plus *no firmaría*: advice, not an order.

yourTurn.prompt: It would be best if you told me the truth. (to a friend)
yourTurn.answer: Lo mejor sería que me dijeras la verdad.
yourTurn.why: *Dijeras* is the *tú* form of the imagined verb.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it formal: Si yo fuera tú, no firmaría. Say it to someone you call *usted*.
yourTurn.answer: Si yo fuera usted, no firmaría.
yourTurn.why: Only *tú* becomes *usted*; the verbs stay the same.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it about we: It would be best if we waited a little.
yourTurn.answer: Lo mejor sería que esperáramos un poco.
yourTurn.why: *We* gives the ending *-ramos*, with the accent on the vowel before it: *esperáramos*.

yourTurn.prompt: I'd recommend that you all think it over.

pitfalls.wrong: Lo mejor sería que vas al médico.
pitfalls.right: Lo mejor sería que fueras al médico.
pitfalls.why: Almost. After *lo mejor sería que* Spanish wants the imagined verb, not the plain *vas*.

pitfalls.wrong: Si yo sería tú, hablaría con ella.
pitfalls.right: Si yo fuera tú, hablaría con ella.
pitfalls.why: Only the second half takes the *would* verb; after *si* use *fuera*.

pitfalls.wrong: Te recomendaría que hablas con ella.
pitfalls.right: Te recomendaría que hablaras con ella.
pitfalls.why: The verb after *que* takes the imagined form, *hablaras*, not *hablas*.

personal: Think of a friend with a problem and give one piece of advice: *Si yo fuera tú,…* or *Lo mejor sería que…*
